title: 'Say what you learned of the flood' stayed on the menu at the drowned nave even after the congregation was already put to rest via 'speak Halm's confession over the water'; using it afterward printed 'The singing doesn't stop' — a non-sequitur, since the singing had already stopped for good moments earlier.
where: The Drowned Nave / 'say what you learned of the flood' (used after 'The Drowned Congregation' was already done)
